Lovely family room with slider to rear property deck, overlooks a beautiful, private, landscaped property. Large sunroom off of Living Room a great space to unwind. Situated on a quiet street in one of Stamford's sought after neighborhoods, this home combines suburban comfort with easy access to local shops, schools, parks, and major commuting routes. Public water/Public sewer. Inspections welcome, however, will be selling As-Is. Great value and Great home to raise a family.
